name: NEOM
verdict: Proposed: serious. NEOM is fully owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, a state fund chaired by the crown prince.
note: DS Penske partner in the joint 'NEOM-SRMG' block on the team site (Season 12, 2025/26); NEOM also owns NEOM SC. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Serious case: the link is neom-pif-ownership (SPA 2019: NEOM 'fully owned by the Public Investment Fund'; HRW 2024 calls NEOM a PIF-funded giga-project); the record is saudi-executions-2025 (HRW + Amnesty) and pif-giga-labour-abuses (HRW, NEOM named).

why.text: NEOM is fully owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, the state's sovereign wealth fund. Saudi Arabia executed at least 356 people in 2025, a record. The logo on DS Penske's Formula E entry is that state's money. That's called sportswashing.
